title: Semantius Copilot agent configuration (agent.jsonc)
description: Per-agent config in agents/<name>/agent.jsonc. The file is REQUIRED: folders without it are skipped by the bundler. Skills live in agents/<name>/skills/<skill>/; an optional INSTRUCTIONS.md next to the config is appended to `instructions`. This schema mirrors validateAgentConfig in core/src/agent.js — change both together.

instructions.description: Agent instructions. An optional INSTRUCTIONS.md in the same folder is appended after this text. At least one of the two must yield non-empty instructions.

model.description: Model specifier. If the first path segment is a known provider (openrouter, custom, cloudflare) the value is used as-is; otherwise 'openrouter/' is prepended (e.g. 'deepseek/deepseek-v4-flash' -> 'openrouter/deepseek/deepseek-v4-flash'). Omit to use the backend's env-derived default (LLM_PROVIDER/LLM_MODEL).

model_base_url.description: Overrides the provider base URL for this agent (an OpenAI-compatible endpoint). Auth still uses the backend's LLM_API_KEY secret.

proxy_whitelist.description: Egress allow list for this agent's sandbox: exact hosts ('www.semantius.com') or '*.suffix' subdomain wildcards ('*.semantius.ai' — subdomains only, not the bare apex). DENY-ALL WHEN ABSENT: an agent without this property (or with an empty list) can make no outbound requests from its sandbox at all.

welcome.description: Welcome card the chat UI shows while a conversation is empty: title/subtitle plus sections of clickable starter prompts. UI-only — never reaches the model. Clicking a prompt sends `prompt ?? display` as the user's message, immediately unless prefill is true (then it only fills the composer). Section/prompt counts are unbounded; only string lengths are capped.

display.description: The label shown on the prompt card.

prompt.description: Optional fuller text actually sent (or prefilled) instead of the display label.

prefill.description: true = clicking only puts the text into the composer for editing; absent/false = clicking sends it immediately.
